theorem_statement: Let g=n=6 and let B^{bal} be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 curves equipped with a balanced tetragonal structure C→P^1 with Tschirnhausen/scroll splitting F≅O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5). Write W_f:=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(-f))|_C for the Casnati–Ekedahl summands (packet convention: W_5 is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2)⊗γ^*F^∨)|_C, not the O(5) summand of F), and set L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}. Let Sym^6_{C/B^{bal}} be the relative effective degree-six divisor space, U^{red}⊂Sym^6 its open locus of reduced support, and Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) the stack of ordered pairwise-distinct sections. Define the unordered evaluation-failure incidence Z^{bal,unord} as the locus of reduced effective Γ of degree 6 with O_C(Γ)≅L, and the ordered model Z^{bal} as its pullback along Conf_6→U^{red}. Then, on every geometric fibre of B^{bal}: (i) deg(W_5)=16 and deg(L)=6; (ii) for any effective Γ of degree 6, H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0 (obstruction degree −4), while deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0 and H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))≠0 if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L; (iii) consequently CE evaluation fails on a reduced degree-six divisor Γ (resp. ordered 6-tuple of distinct points) if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L (resp. the underlying unordered divisor lies in Z^{bal,unord}); (iv) Conf_6→U^{red} is a finite étale S_6-torsor, so Z^{bal}→Z^{bal,unord} is likewise a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open. This constructs and identifies the balanced evaluation-failure locus at the level of geometric points and ordered/unordered reduced-support models; it does not assert scheme-theoretic Fitting equality with a CE degeneracy ideal, fibrewise nonemptiness of U^{red}∩|L|, closed pure-codimension embedding in M_{6,6}, h^0-stratification, components/stabilizers, or Tate type.
